stops.note: literally three strings, from se (three) and tar (string)
adapted into South Asian classical music for the long-necked stringed instrument
Persian 'three strings'; Ravi Shankar taught George Harrison, who played it on 'Norwegian Wood' (1965)
stops.meaning: a long-necked South Asian stringed instrument

current_meaning: a long-necked, plucked stringed instrument used in South Asian classical music
